hooks.text: 绝大多数操作被剥夺，只能滑动鼠标行动，而点击反会触发意外危险
hooks.excerpt: You have been deprived of most of your control methods. What happened? Try to understand the world when you can only slide the mouse. But if you click the mouse, unexpected and dangerous things will happen.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 世界里藏有待破解的隐秘机关，宝箱小道具可作为解谜辅助
hooks.excerpt: There are various hidden mechanisms around the world waiting for you to crack. You can get different small props in the treasure chest, let them help you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个限时循环都要滑鼠斩怪、解开知识锁定的谜题并寻找隐藏路线，尽量深入世界真相
hooks.excerpt: In each time loop, slide the mouse to kill monsters, crack the puzzles locked by knowledge, and explore the hidden paths! Go deeper in a limited time and discover the truth of the world.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
